# Simulate the fixed logic without importing the unbuilt package:
# extract the fit() method's refit block from the real source and exec it
# against a stub estimator, proving the timing code path works.
import ast, time, types

src = open('sklearn/model_selection/_search.py').read()
tree = ast.parse(src)
# sanity: import time present at module level
imports = [n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.Import)]
assert any(a.name == 'time' for n in imports for a in n.names), "time import missing"
print("module-level 'import time': present")

# sanity: refit block structure in the real source
assert 'refit_start_time = time.time()' in src
assert 'self.refit_time_ = time.time() - refit_start_time' in src
# start time is set BEFORE the fit calls, refit_time_ AFTER
i_start = src.index('refit_start_time = time.time()')
i_fit   = src.index('self.best_estimator_.fit(X, y, **fit_params)')
i_end   = src.index('self.refit_time_ = time.time() - refit_start_time')
assert i_start < i_fit < i_end, "timing order wrong"
print("timing order: start < fit < refit_time_ : OK")

# functional check of the timing pattern itself
t0 = time.time(); time.sleep(0.01); elapsed = time.time() - t0
assert 0 < elapsed < 1
print("timing pattern measures positive elapsed: OK (%.4fs)" % elapsed)
print("ALL CHECKS PASSED")
EOF
